entities.summary: Micon the Younger of Athens, simply Micon or Mikon was an ancient Greek painter and sculptor from the middle of the 5th century BC. He was closely associated with Polygnotus of Thasos, in conjunction with whom he adorned the Stoa poikile, at Athens, with paintings of the Battle of Marathon and other battles. He also painted in the Anakeion at Athens. His daughter was the painter Timarete. Micon was a painters & sculptors from Classical Athens (500 BCE, Classical Athens–500 BCE). historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Micon's paintings in the Stoa poikile and Anakeion at Athens had a significant regional impact on Classical Greek art and culture, influencing subsequent generations of artists. His association with Polygnotus also highlights the importance of artistic collaboration during this period.
